briefing.headline: OpenAI and xAI escalate frontier model race with new multimodal releases

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AI race intensifies as major labs push boundaries on reasoning and agentic systems amid regulatory scrutiny. Funding remains robust while safety concerns grow over deployment at scale.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released o4-preview with advanced chain-of-thought capabilities. xAI launched Grok-3 featuring real-time web integration while Anthropic and Google prepare Claude 4 and Gemini 2.5 updates.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. New EU AI Act enforcement begins targeting high-risk agents.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA ships Blackwell Ultra chips to Microsoft and Google data centers. TSMC reports record AI accelerator orders for Q4 2026.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will multi-agent systems achieve autonomous economic productivity before 2028?
